Master Stark

Overview

Master Stark is the overworked master serving the Canian garrison. He claims inherited expertise in smithing, spellcraft and complex potions, and complains that people visit only when they need something. He introduces the travellers to Uncle Rad’s covert role and is intrigued by the unusual alloy they later bring him. [1, 2, 3]

Return to Jigran and Dar-Leanos

The old portal brings the travellers to the Canian side of Jigran, where Baron Virril questions their arrival amid attacks by the undead. The baron has lost Dar-Ulgorn to Firez’s forces but refuses Kir’s suggestion to seek outside help, citing his family’s pride. Kir and Kel assist the endangered settlements. They meet the baron’s son Dartas and the overworked Master Stark. Stark provides a password for Uncle Rad, a seller of sweets who secretly gathers intelligence for the baron. These local alliances make the campaign against Firez possible. [4, 5, 6, 1, 7, 2, 8]

Weapons, Dartas and preparations for war

Kir proposes a special weapon alloy against the undead, drawing on a book he read. Stark sends him to an abandoned forge rather than allow a youngster to work in his own smithy. When Kir returns with the alloy, Kel recognises the source of the craftsman’s resistance: a hereditary master is ashamed of learning something his father never taught him. Kir presents the discovery as knowledge Stark can pass to his own son. The smith agrees to try it, and the baron welcomes the advantage for his soldiers. The improved weapons strengthen his preparations for an offensive. [9, 10, 3, 11, 12, 13, 14]
